label: System operator
definition: Body licensed to run the GB electricity system in real time and to buy the balancing services it needs.

label: Distribution network operator (group)
definition: A distribution network operator as it presents itself to the market, usually a trading name covering one or more licensed distribution companies.

label: Distribution licensee
definition: A company that holds an Ofgem electricity distribution licence for one of the 14 regional DNO licence areas.

label: Exchange
definition: An organised trading venue that lists standard power contracts (spot or derivatives) and matches buyers and sellers.

label: Regulator
definition: The body that regulates the GB energy sector and its licensees.

label: Government department
definition: A UK government department that sets energy policy and owns government-backed schemes.

label: Scheme counterparty
definition: A company that holds the contracts with scheme participants and makes or collects the scheme payments.

label: Settlement agent
definition: A company that calculates and administers settlement of a scheme on behalf of its counterparty or settlement body.

label: Code administrator
definition: A company that administers an industry code and runs the central systems and processes that the code requires.

label: Industry body
definition: An association of licensed companies that develops shared guidance and standards but does not run mechanisms itself.
